# AgentsView

> AgentsView is a local-first system of record for AI coding agent sessions: a daemon syncs sessions from more than 60 agent harnesses into a searchable SQLite archive with transcripts, activity, token and cost reports, quality signals, and recall, served through a web UI, desktop app, CLI, REST API, and MCP server.

Every public page is also published as raw Markdown at the route listed below.
The Markdown pages are canonical for machine readers; the HTML routes drop the
`.md` suffix and end with a trailing slash (for example `/docs/quickstart/`).

## Product

- [AgentsView](https://agentsview.io/index.md): The system of record for your AI coding agents.
- [The session intelligence loop](https://agentsview.io/guide.md): A nine-stop tour from session capture to the agent feedback loop.

## Start Here

- [Documentation overview](https://agentsview.io/docs/index.md): Mental model and documentation map.
- [Quick Start](https://agentsview.io/docs/quickstart.md): Get AgentsView running in under a minute.
- [Configuration](https://agentsview.io/docs/configuration.md): Config file, default paths, and runtime settings.
- [Usage Guide](https://agentsview.io/docs/usage.md): Complete guide to the AgentsView web interface.
- [CLI Reference](https://agentsview.io/docs/commands.md): All AgentsView commands, flags, and environment variables.

## Monitor and Account

- [Activity](https://agentsview.io/docs/activity.md): Activity, concurrency, and session-time reporting.
- [Token Usage & Costs](https://agentsview.io/docs/token-usage.md): Fast token usage and cost reports from the local database.
- [One-shot CI Capture](https://agentsview.io/docs/one-shot-capture.md): Capture exact usage from one supported non-interactive agent execution.
- [Stats](https://agentsview.io/docs/stats.md): Experimental workspace analytics via agentsview stats.
- [Reporting Export](https://agentsview.io/docs/reporting-export.md): Canonical hourly activity and usage exports for reporting integrations.

## Understand

- [Session Intelligence](https://agentsview.io/docs/session-intelligence.md): Health scores, outcomes, and session-quality analytics.
- [Quality](https://agentsview.io/docs/quality.md): Deterministic quality signals and recommendations computed from session data.
- [Semantic Search](https://agentsview.io/docs/semantic-search.md): Vector search over session messages, plus hybrid search and cursor-based context retrieval.
- [Semantic Search Internals](https://agentsview.io/docs/semantic-search-internals.md): Architecture and invariants behind the vector index.
- [Recall](https://agentsview.io/docs/recall.md): Experimental, provenance-linked durable knowledge over the local session archive.
- [Recent Edits](https://agentsview.io/docs/recent-edits.md): Browse the files your agents edited most recently across every session.
- [Data](https://agentsview.io/docs/data.md): Project inventory and worktree mapping rules.

## Automate and Integrate

- [MCP Server](https://agentsview.io/docs/mcp.md): Connect assistant clients to your session history with MCP.
- [Session API](https://agentsview.io/docs/session-api.md): Programmatic access to session data via the CLI and REST endpoints.
- [Session Export](https://agentsview.io/docs/session-export.md): Content-free session summary exports for scripting and analytics.
- [Chat Import](https://agentsview.io/docs/chat-import.md): Import Claude.ai, ChatGPT, and Gemini Apps conversations.

## Sync and Share

- [PostgreSQL Sync](https://agentsview.io/docs/pg-sync.md): Push sync, an auto-push service, and a read-only server for teams.
- [DuckDB Mirror](https://agentsview.io/docs/duckdb.md): Mirror the SQLite archive into DuckDB, locally or over the Quack remote protocol.
- [Filesystem Session Sync](https://agentsview.io/docs/filesystem-sync.md): View sessions from multiple machines by transporting native session directories.
- [Artifact Folder Sync](https://agentsview.io/docs/artifact-sync.md): Exchange normalized sessions between archives through a trusted folder.
- [Hosted Raw Sync](https://agentsview.io/docs/hosted-raw-sync.md): Keep original provider files from several devices in one hosted archive with authenticated, resumable uploads.
- [Remote Access](https://agentsview.io/docs/remote-access.md): Access AgentsView from other devices on your network.
